subject: Quick thought on the Florida Smile Studio website
body: Hi team at Florida Smile Studio, I really admire your focus on biological and holistic dental practices here in Fort Lauderdale, especially your use of mercury-free and metal-free biocompatible materials. While looking over your current site, I noticed a couple of friction points like dense text blocks and the absence of a prominent scheduling widget, which can make it tough for health-conscious patients to book on mobile. Because I enjoy working with local wellness practices, I went ahead and put together a fast, modern prototype for you. You can take a look at the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x88d9004def10d033-0x9e74489b2e4584a-3uwikt24h.vercel.app. It features a streamlined clean corporate design, a clear hero CTA, and an optimized services grid. Feel free to check out the live preview. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a prominent scheduling CTA in the hero banner
Streamlined the inquiry form to reduce friction fields
Added trust badges and patient review snippets above the fold
